name: VR Heads or Tails
summary: VR Heads or Tails is a coin-flip style EA that randomly decides market direction (heads=buy, tails=sell) and employs a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade to recover losses. It is essentially a gambling-based system with no technical analysis, relying purely on probability and progressive lot scaling to achieve net profit.
summary_zh: VR Heads or Tails是一个抛硬币式EA，随机决定市场方向（正面=买入，反面=卖出），并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后加倍手数以回收损失。该系统本质上是一个基于赌博逻辑的交易策略，不使用任何技术分析，完全依赖概率和递增仓位来追求盈利。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于随机概率，类似于抛硬币决定买入或卖出，没有任何技术指标或市场分析的参与。入场条件完全随机，通过随机数生成器决定开多或开空，不考虑价格走势、趋势方向或市场状态。出场条件依赖于止盈和止损设置，但核心机制在于亏损后加倍仓位。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔策略，每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，试图用一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面，由于手数呈指数增长，连续亏损会迅速耗尽账户余额，风险极高。该策略没有任何风控机制来限制最大连续亏损次数或最大仓位上限，账户爆仓风险极大。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on random probability, similar to flipping a coin to decide buy or sell, with no technical indicators or market analysis involved. Entry conditions are entirely random, using a random number generator to determine whether to open a long or short position, disregarding price action, trend direction, or market conditions. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss settings, but the core mechanism lies in doubling position size after a loss. Position sizing employs the classic Martingale strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade in an attempt to recover all previous losses with a single win. Money management is extremely risky as the lot size grows exponentially, meaning a series of consecutive losses can quickly deplete the entire account balance. There is no risk control mechanism to limit the maximum number of consecutive losses or a maximum position cap, making account blow-up a very real possibility.

pros: 逻辑简单易懂，代码结构清晰，适合初学者理解马丁格尔原理
在短周期且运气好的情况下可以快速回收亏损并获利
随机入场消除了情绪干扰，严格执行策略规则不带主观判断
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand logic with clean code structure, suitable for beginners to understand Martingale principles
Can quickly recover losses and profit in short periods when luck is favorable
Random entry eliminates emotional interference, strictly executing strategy rules without subjective judgment
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数呈指数增长，极易导致账户爆仓
没有任何技术分析或市场判断，纯随机入场与赌博无异
缺乏最大仓位限制和最大连续亏损次数控制，风控机制严重不足
长期数学期望为负，经纪商的点差和滑点会持续侵蚀资金
cons_en: Martingale strategy causes lot sizes to grow exponentially during consecutive losses, easily leading to account blow-up
No technical analysis or market judgment whatsoever, pure random entry is equivalent to gambling
Lacks maximum position limit and maximum consecutive loss count control, severely insufficient risk management
Long-term mathematical expectation is negative as broker spreads and slippage continuously erode capital
improvements: 增加最大仓位上限和最大马丁格尔层数限制，防止指数级仓位增长导致爆仓
加入技术指标过滤（如趋势方向、支撑阻力位）替代纯随机入场，提高胜率
improvements_en: Add maximum position cap and maximum Martingale level limit to prevent exponential position growth leading to account blow-up
Incorporate technical indicator filters (such as trend direction, support/resistance levels) instead of pure random entry to improve win rate

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略手数指数增长，连续亏损可迅速耗尽全部资金
无最大仓位限制，无连续亏损次数上限，账户爆仓风险极高
纯随机入场无任何市场分析支撑，胜率理论上接近50%但扣除点差后为负期望
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy lot size grows exponentially, consecutive losses can rapidly deplete all funds
No maximum position limit or consecutive loss cap, extremely high account blow-up risk
Pure random entry without any market analysis support, win rate theoretically near 50% but negative expectation after spreads
